recipes.name: Banana oatmeal
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Microwave
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Stir the oats and milk together in a deep microwave-safe container.
Heat in short bursts according to the oat packet, stirring between bursts. Let the oats stand until softened.
Peel the banana, break it into pieces and stir it into the oats.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Combine the oats and milk in a pot. Warm gently on the hob, stirring until the oats soften.
Take the pot off the heat. Peel the banana, break it into pieces and fold it into the oats.

recipes.name: Peanut butter and banana bread
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Spread the peanut butter on the sliced bread with the back of a spoon.
Peel the banana and break it into small pieces. Gently press the pieces onto the bread.

recipes.name: Apple yogurt bowl
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water for rinsing produce.
steps: Rinse the apple. On the cutting board, core and chop it with the knife.
Spoon the yogurt into a bowl, then stir in the oats and the chopped apple.

recipes.name: Sweet couscous with raisins
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Kettle
methods.water: Use the amount of potable water specified on the instant couscous packet.
steps: Heat plain water in the kettle. Put the couscous and raisins into a separate heatproof bowl.
Pour in hot water following the couscous packet and let the grains absorb it for the stated time.
Fluff with a spoon and pour the milk directly into the bowl to serve.

recipes.name: Chickpea couscous bowl
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Kettle
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the tomato and hydrate the couscous according to its packet.
steps: Heat plain water in the kettle. Put the couscous in a heatproof bowl, add hot water as directed on the packet and let it absorb.
Rinse the tomato and dice it on the cutting board. Open the ready-to-eat chickpeas and pour off the packing liquid.
Stir the chickpeas, diced tomato and oil through the couscous with the spoon.

recipes.name: Lentil salad with bread
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water for rinsing produce.
steps: Rinse the cucumber and tomato. Chop both into bite-sized pieces on the cutting board.
Open the ready-to-eat lentils and pour off the packing liquid. Mix the lentils and vegetables in a bowl and serve with the bread.

recipes.name: Bean and corn tortilla
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Open the ready-to-eat beans and sweetcorn and pour off the packing liquid.
Mash some of the beans in a bowl with the back of a spoon. Fold in the corn and serve with the tortilla, spooning in filling as you eat.

methods.name: Microwave
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Open the ready-to-eat beans and corn and pour off the packing liquid. Transfer both to the microwave-safe container.
Warm in short bursts, stirring between bursts. Serve with the tortilla and spoon in filling as you eat.

recipes.name: Tuna cucumber wraps
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water for rinsing produce.
steps: Rinse the cucumber and dice it on the cutting board. Open the tuna and pour off its packing liquid.
Flake the tuna into a bowl and stir in the cucumber. Spoon the mixture onto the tortillas and roll them up.

recipes.name: Cheese and tomato toastie
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Sandwich maker
methods.water: Potable water for rinsing produce.
steps: Rinse the tomato and slice it on the cutting board. Layer the cheese and tomato between slices of bread.
Preheat the sandwich maker as directed by its manual. Toast the sandwich according to the appliance instructions until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Tomato pasta
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Use potable cooking water as directed on the pasta packet.
steps: Bring the packet-directed amount of water to a boil in a pot. Add the pasta and cook for the stated time.
Drain the pasta in the strainer. Warm the passata and oil in the same pot, stir the pasta back in and heat through.

recipes.name: Rice and beans
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Use the amount of potable water given on the rice packet for absorption cooking.
steps: Cook the rice and measured water in the lidded pot following the rice packet.
Open the ready-to-eat beans and pour off the packing liquid. Spoon the beans into the cooked rice, stir over low heat and serve.

methods.name: Rice cooker
methods.water: Measure potable water for the rice using the rice cooker and product instructions.
steps: Put the rice and water in the rice cooker, using the amounts and cycle specified by the appliance and rice packet.
Open the ready-to-eat beans and pour off the packing liquid. Spoon the cooked rice into a bowl and fold in the beans just before serving.

recipes.name: Vegetable rice
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Use potable water according to the rice and frozen vegetable packet instructions.
steps: Cook the rice in water in the lidded pot following its packet. Spoon the cooked rice into a bowl.
Cook the frozen vegetables in the same pot according to their packet. Stir the rice and oil into the cooked vegetables and heat through.

recipes.name: Potato with beans
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Microwave
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the potato and moisten the bottom of the microwave-safe container.
steps: Rinse the potato and dice it on the cutting board. Put the pieces in the microwave-safe container with enough water to moisten the bottom.
Microwave until tender, checking and stirring in intervals. Open the ready-to-eat beans, pour off the packing liquid and stir them into the potato.
Warm the mixture through, then let it stand briefly before serving.

recipes.name: Roasted potatoes and chickpeas
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Mini oven
methods.water: Potable water for rinsing produce.
steps: Use the mini oven manual’s temperature and preheating guidance for roasting potatoes. Rinse the potatoes and cut them into small cubes on the board.
Use the spoon to coat the potato with oil on the oven-safe tray. Roast until almost tender. Open and drain the ready-to-eat chickpeas.
Add the chickpeas to the tray and finish roasting until the potato is tender and the chickpeas are hot.

recipes.name: Vegetable soup and crackers
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Microwave
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Open the ready-to-heat soup and transfer it to the microwave-safe container.
Microwave according to the soup label, stirring between intervals. Serve with the crackers.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Open the ready-to-heat soup and pour it into a pot. Heat on the hob following the soup label, stirring occasionally.
Take the soup off the heat and serve with crackers.

recipes.name: Potato and lentil pot
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Use potable water to rinse the vegetables and enough to cover them in the pot.
steps: Rinse the potato and carrot and cut them into small pieces on the board. Put the vegetables in the pot and add water to cover.
Simmer with the lid until the vegetables are tender. Open and drain the ready-to-eat lentils, add them to the pot and heat through.

recipes.name: Pear and puffed rice cereal
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse and core the pear, then dice it on the board.
Pour the puffed rice into a bowl. Top with the pear and add the oat drink just before eating with a spoon.

recipes.name: Apple and apricot muesli
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Cut the pitted dried apricots into small pieces on the board.
Open the apple puree into a bowl. Stir in the cold-use oats and apricots with a spoon and let stand briefly to soften.

recipes.name: Sunflower and jam cracker plate
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Lay out the crackers and open the two single-use sachets.
Use the back of the spoon to spread sunflower seed butter on the crackers. Finish each with a little jam.

recipes.name: Orange and pear salad with rice crunch
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse the fruit. Peel and segment the orange, then core and dice the pear on the board.
Combine the fruit and its juice in a bowl. Fold in the crisp rice with a spoon immediately before serving.

recipes.name: Pear porridge with oat drink
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse, core and dice the pear on the board. Put it in the pot with the oats and oat drink.
Heat gently on the hob, stirring with a spoon until the oats and pear soften. Let stand briefly before serving.

recipes.name: Warm raisin rice pudding
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Microwave
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Empty the pouch of cooked rice into a deep microwave-safe container. Mix in the oat drink and raisins.
Microwave in short intervals, stirring between bursts until hot and creamy. Let stand briefly and serve.

recipes.name: Beetroot and chickpea salad
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Open the cooked beetroot pouch and drain the chickpeas. Tip the soft beet pieces into a bowl.
Fold in the chickpeas and oil with the spoon, lightly crushing some of the beetroot to coat the chickpeas.

recipes.name: Hummus and pepper open sandwiches
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse the pepper, remove its stem and seeds and cut it into thin strips on the board.
Spread the whole hummus portion on the sliced bread with a spoon. Arrange the pepper strips on top.

recipes.name: Sardine and cucumber cracker plate
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse the cucumber and slice it on the board. Open the sardine can and drain it.
Flake the boneless fish in a bowl with the spoon. Serve alongside the cucumber slices and crackers for topping as you eat.

recipes.name: Cold rice and pea bowl
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse the carrot and cut it into small pieces on the board. Drain the cooked peas.
Empty the ready-to-eat rice pouch into a bowl. Break up the grains with a spoon, then mix in the peas, carrot and oil.

recipes.name: Crunchy cabbage and hummus wrap
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse the vegetables. Slice the cabbage finely and cut the carrot into thin sticks on the board.
Spread the hummus over the tortilla with a spoon. Fold around the vegetables and serve any extra slaw alongside.

recipes.name: Beet and bean dip with crackers
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Drain the beans and tip them into a bowl. Crush them with the back of a spoon until spreadable.
Mash the soft cooked beet pieces into the beans. Serve the dip with crackers, leaving a little texture.

recipes.name: Potato mash with peas
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Kettle
methods.water: Heat the potable water required by the supplied plain potato-flake directions.
steps: Heat plain water in the kettle. Put the potato flakes in a separate heatproof bowl and add hot water following the supplied flake directions.
Stir in the oil with the spoon. Drain the ready peas and fold them through the mash just before serving.

recipes.name: Couscous-stuffed pepper halves
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Kettle
methods.water: Use potable water to rinse the pepper and hydrate the couscous as directed.
steps: Heat plain water in the kettle. Hydrate the couscous with it in the separate heatproof bowl, following the supplied product directions.
Rinse the pepper, halve it on the board and remove the seeds and stem. Stir the hummus into the couscous and spoon the filling into the raw pepper halves.

recipes.name: Red lentil and carrot soup
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Use potable water to rinse produce and cook the lentils to a loose soup consistency.
steps: Rinse and dice the carrot, then peel and chop the onion on the board. Soften both in oil in the pot.
Add the dry split red lentils and water. Simmer following the supplied lentil directions until the lentils are cooked and soft, stirring and adding water for a spoonable soup.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and red lentil stew
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Use potable water to wash the sweet potato and cook the lentils as directed.
steps: Scrub the sweet potato and dice it small on the board. Put it in the pot with the dry lentils and the water needed for cooking.
Simmer following the lentil directions until the lentils are cooked and the sweet potato softens. Stir in the passata and heat through to a thick stew.

recipes.name: Spinach and pea pasta
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Use potable water for rinsing the spinach and boiling the pasta.
steps: Rinse the spinach. Boil the pasta in the pot as directed and drain it in the strainer.
Return the pasta to the pot. Add the oil, drained cooked peas and spinach. Stir over low heat until the leaves wilt and everything is hot.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and hummus bowl
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Microwave
methods.water: Use potable water to wash the vegetables and moisten the cooking container.
steps: Scrub the sweet potato, dice it on the board and put it in the microwave-safe container with water to moisten the bottom.
Microwave in intervals, stirring until tender. Rinse and tear in the spinach and heat briefly until wilted. Stir in the opened hummus portion with a spoon.

recipes.name: Rice and sardine stuffed tomatoes
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: No heat
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse the tomatoes, halve them on the board and use a spoon to scoop their centers into a bowl.
Open the cooked rice and mix it into the tomato centers with the drained, flaked sardines. Spoon the mixture back into the tomato shells and serve excess filling alongside.

recipes.name: Apple and cheese tortilla pockets
recipes.provenance: Original NoKitchen synthetic model recipe; quantities and methods are demo fixtures.

methods.name: Sandwich maker
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Rinse and core the apple, then slice it thinly on the board. Fill half of the tortilla with the cheese and apple and fold it closed.
Warm the closed pocket in the sandwich maker following its manual, allowing space at the edges. Serve any remaining apple alongside.

recipes.name: Beetroot and cheese gratin

methods.name: Mini oven
methods.water: No added water.
steps: Preheat the mini oven following its manual for baking a small vegetable dish. Place the soft beet pieces on the oven-safe tray.
Crumble some crackers over the beetroot with a spoon. Cover with cheese and bake until the food is hot and the cheese melts. Serve the remaining crackers with it.

methods.name: Mini oven
methods.water: Potable water to rinse the produce.
steps: Preheat the mini oven for baking thin flatbreads following its manual. Rinse the tomato, slice it on the board and drain the sweetcorn.
Lay the tortillas on the oven-safe tray. Top with the tomato, use the spoon to distribute the corn, then add cheese. Bake until crisp at the edges and hot throughout.

methods.name: Hob
methods.water: Use potable water to rinse the vegetables and boil the potatoes.
steps: Rinse the potatoes and cabbage. Cube the potatoes and slice the cabbage and peeled onion on the board. Start the potatoes in a pot of water.
When the potatoes begin to soften, add the cabbage and onion. Cook until tender, drain in the strainer and return everything to the pot. Roughly crush with the spoon and fold in the oil.
